_comment: PHASE 3 - seismic scenarios. The trigger enters as a pseudo-static coefficient k_h = pga_fraction * PGA added to the force balance, not as a lookup. pga_fraction is a convention, not a fit, and it matters: over its plausible range 0.3-1.0 the unstable area runs from 57 to 90 per cent. Quote seismic results as a range over it. step5 also writes the Newmark critical acceleration, which is the map to read against a shaking scenario.
